sources.name: Investor.gov (SEC)
sources.note: Cite "Source: U.S. SEC, Investor.gov". No SEC seal or logos, no endorsement claim, no third-party material.

sources.name: IRS
sources.note: Cite "Source: IRS" with the tax year. The English page is authoritative; /vi is a terminology aid only.

sources.name: CFPB
sources.note: Cite "Source: CFPB". No logo. Recheck links at review: the site moves pages.

sources.name: Vietnamese laws (vbpl.vn)
sources.note: Give the law number, article and in-force date. The owner pastes the text in: the site needs JavaScript.

sources.name: SSC / UBCKNN
sources.note: Explain in our own words, cite laws and circulars by number, never paraphrase SSC articles closely.

sources.name: State Bank of Vietnam
sources.note: Its circulars may be quoted; its "Phổ biến kiến thức" articles may not.

sources.name: HNX
sources.note: Its glossary is for checking terminology only: never reproduce it.

sources.name: FINRA
sources.note: Further reading only. Never in a drafting prompt, never paraphrased, never framed.

sources.name: HOSE
sources.note: Its market data is a paid product.

sources.name: Tax Department (Cục Thuế)
sources.note: Link-only until vetted from a Vietnamese connection.

sources.name: CIC
sources.note: Link-only until vetted from a Vietnamese connection.

sources.name: YouTube (owner-picked channels)
sources.note: Embed only, privacy-enhanced, autoplay off. A video the owner has watched; never summarised.
